So amide attached to heterocycle with N substituent bearing benzyl attached to phenyl with side chain CN4CC(F)C4 (a fluorinated azetidine? Actually N4CC(F)C4 is a 3-member? N4CC(F)C4 is a azetidine (four-member) with fluorine. So overall complex.

Another disconnection: formation of heterocycle (triazine) via cyclization from appropriate precursors. Another disconnection: introduction of benzyl side chain with azetidine via SN2 on benzyl halide.

We need commercially available leaves: maybe 4-methoxyaniline, 4-(benzyl)aniline? Actually the anisole phenyl with amide attached at para? The SMILES: COc1cccc(NC(=O)... )c1. Could be synthesized from 2-aminopyrimidine? Might be complex.
